title: Monster room reimagined
description: A modern interpretation of the monster room feature.
body:
**Contents:**

This pack adds a new structure that is supposed to replace minecraft's classic monster room. It adds extended loot tables and 78 different structure tiles (including rare ones) to ensure variety among them.

**The monster room in question:**

![An example of the new monster room](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a345f34115bac33b13db33d7e4c8a699bfe18f55_0.webp)

**An example of what you could expect in a loot chest:**

![An example of the new loot table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b808a0c8ce8535407cfa06c259d29419bb96b93.png)

**Known bugs:**
- Carving features occasionally fully exposes the structure.
- Due to the randomness of the structure it has a chance to spawn without any chests.
